tickerText: [TENNIS] Davis Cup Qualifier ties roll on Sept. 19 as Ben Shelton falls 6-4, 6-4 to Jiri Lehecka to leave USA–Czechia 1-1 after Learner Tien's debut win, South Korea leads India 2-0, and Great Britain opens against Ecuador at London's Copper Box • [SQUASH] QTerminals Qatar Classic wraps in Doha with Mostafa Asal sweeping Victor Crouin 11-5, 11-6, 11-2 for his first Doha title and Amina Orfi edging Hania El Hammamy in five to claim women's gold and the world No. 1 spot • [BADMINTON] Aichi-Nagoya Asian Games open Sept. 19 as team draws set India women versus Kazakhstan on Sunday and men versus Bangladesh Monday ahead of Ichinomiya play Sept. 20–29 • [PICKLEBALL] Veolia Arizona Open semifinal Saturday in Mesa after a wild week that sent Tyson McGuffin home early and pits Ben Johns against Federico Staksrud with 1,000 PPA points live on PickleballTV and FS2 • [TABLE TENNIS] WTT Star Contender Astana hits Sept. 19 with women's and men's singles round of 16, mixed doubles semis at 11:00 and evening singles quarterfinals plus doubles finals at Martial Arts Palace

newsItems.title: Asal and Orfi Crowned in Doha
newsItems.excerpt: Egypt swept both Qatar Classic finals Sept. 18 as world No. 1 Mostafa Asal beat Victor Crouin in straight games and Amina Orfi outlasted Hania El Hammamy in five to take her first Doha title and the women's top ranking.

newsItems.title: Asian Games Team Draws Set
newsItems.excerpt: Badminton team brackets for Aichi-Nagoya were revealed Sept. 19, sending India's women into a Sunday round-of-16 tie with Kazakhstan and the men against Bangladesh on Monday before singles and doubles week in Ichinomiya.

newsItems.title: Arizona Open Semifinal Saturday
newsItems.excerpt: The Veolia Arizona Open reaches pro semifinals Sept. 19 in Mesa after upsets shook the draws, including a Johns–Staksrud singles quarterfinal clash, with championship Sunday and 1,000 ranking points on the line.

newsItems.title: Astana Singles R16 Day
newsItems.excerpt: WTT Star Contender Astana's Saturday slate features women's and men's singles round of 16 and mixed doubles semifinals before evening quarterfinals and doubles finals cap play at the Martial Arts Palace in Kazakhstan.
